faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How much can I save with solar panels?
faq.answer1: Savings vary based on your energy consumption, system size, and local sunlight conditions. Our calculator can give you an estimate, and we can provide a detailed analysis.
faq.question2: How long does the installation take?
faq.answer2: A typical residential installation can take 1-3 days. Larger commercial projects may take longer.
faq.question3: What maintenance is required for solar panels?
faq.answer3: Solar panels require minimal maintenance, usually just occasional cleaning and an annual check-up to ensure optimal performance.
